# GitHub

> > GitHub is the AI-powered developer platform for building, collaborating, and securing software with tools like GitHub Copilot, Actions, and Codespaces.

GitHub provides cloud-based Git repository hosting, CI/CD automation, AI-assisted coding, security scanning, and collaboration tools for millions of developers worldwide. The platform combines version control with DevOps workflows, code review, project management, and an extensive marketplace of integrations.

## Key Topics

- GitHub Copilot
- GitHub Actions
- GitHub Codespaces
- GitHub Advanced Security
- AI-powered coding assistant
- CI/CD automation
- Code security and vulnerability scanning
- Open-source collaboration
- Developer platform and tools
- GitHub CLI and Desktop
- GitHub Packages
- GitHub Sponsors
- DevOps workflows
- Version control with Git

## Platform Overview

- [GitHub Homepage](https://github.com/): AI-powered developer platform homepage featuring GitHub Copilot & Actions
- [GitHub Features](https://github.com/features): Overview of GitHub platform features: Copilot, Actions, Codespaces & more
- [GitHub Organization](https://github.com/github): GitHub's official organization profile with 535 repositories and products

## Documentation

- [GitHub Documentation](https://docs.github.com/): Complete documentation hub for GitHub products, tools, and workflows
